about: Prompts that need a workflow and a wait, for counting how the owner waits: workflow_status calls (polling) against the <workflow_notification>s it gets. Each runs to its end.

prompts.prompt: Start a workflow that runs `sleep 45 && ls lib` as a job on your volume, and tell me its output when it finishes.
Start two workflows, one running the job `sleep 20 && echo first` and one running `sleep 60 && echo second`, both on your volume. Tell me each one's output as it finishes.

Start a workflow with three worker agents, each writing a one-line summary of one of /repo/docs/d001.md, d002.md and d003.md (give each repo: your volume), and return their summaries. Tell me the three summaries when it is done.
